extracted.intended_audience: registered patent attorneys, USPTO Office of Enrollment and Discipline (OED) staff, and attorneys facing reciprocal discipline before the USPTO
extracted.subtask_description: A Final Order under 37 C.F.R. §11.24 excluding a registered practitioner from practice before the USPTO based on state bar disbarment and directing compliance with USPTO disciplinary and notification rules. Covers procedural requirements for response, notice, service, duties while excluded, and reinstatement procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion under 37 C.F.R. §11.24 (reciprocal discipline)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to 37 C.F.R. §11.24(d), the Director of the USPTO orders the exclusion of Respondent from the practice of patent, trademark, and other non-patent law before the USPTO for violation of ethical standards set out in 37 C.F.R. §10.23(a) and (b), as further identified under 37 C.F.R. §10.23(c)(5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The exclusion is based on a state bar disbarment (here, June 10, 2008 Order of Disbarment of the District 06A Grievance Committee of the State Bar of Texas). The Order identifies the statutory/regulatory authority for exclusion (35 U.S.C. §32 and 37 C.F.R. §11.24).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice and opportunity to respond under 37 C.F.R. §11.24
rubrics_metrics.description: A 'Notice and Order Under 37 C.F.R. §11.24' was mailed directing Respondent to file, within 40 days, a response containing all information Respondent believes is sufficient to establish a genuine issue of material fact that the imposition of discipline identical to that imposed by the state grievance committee would be unwarranted based upon any of the grounds permissible under 37 C.F.R. §11.24(d)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to file the required response results in a determination that there is no genuine issue of material fact under §11.24(d) and supports imposition of identical discipline. The Notice/Response timeline and substance are procedural prerequisites in reciprocal-discipline proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethical violations cited under 37 C.F.R. §10.23(a), (b), and (c)(5)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director found violation of the ethical standards set out in 37 C.F.R. §10.23(a) and (b), as further identified under 37 C.F.R. §10.23(c)(5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order identifies specific misconduct supporting the underlying state disbarment (charged and collected unconscionable fees; did not provide client's file upon request until the client paid $540). These factual findings illustrate the types of misconduct that can support reciprocal exclusion under the cited ethics provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority to act: 35 U.S.C. §32 and 37 C.F.R. §11.24
rubrics_metrics.description: This action is taken pursuant to the provisions of 35 U.S.C. §32 and 37 C.F.R. §11.24.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statutory and regulatory authority cited as the basis for exclusion and related procedures, including publication and notice obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of notice in the Official Gazette
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that the OED Director publish the following notice in the Official Gazette: NOTICE OF EXCLUSION (text naming Respondent, registration number, grounds for exclusion, and effective date).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Order includes a model notice specifying the practitioner's name, registration number, the disciplinary finding (e.g., disbarment for charging unconscionable fees and withholding a client's file), and the effective date of exclusion (here, February 13, 2009).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification to USPTO employees, federal agencies, and state authorities
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that the OED Director shall give notice of this Final Order to 1) appropriate employees of the USPTO; 2) interested departments, agencies, and consuls of the United States; and 3) appropriate authorities of any State in which Respondent is known to be a member of the bar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Order requires dissemination of the Final Order to internal USPTO personnel, relevant federal bodies, and state bar authorities where the respondent is admitted—procedural requirement to effectuate reciprocal discipline and inform stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(a)
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that Respondent shall comply with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order directs compliance with §11.58(a) while excluded. The text of §11.58(a) is not reproduced in the Order; the Order mandates adherence to that regulatory duty during the exclusion period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(b)(1)
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that Respondent comply with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(b)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Order explicitly lists each subsection of §11.58(b) (1)–(6) as separate compliance obligations; the regulatory content is not restated in the Order but is required conduct while excluded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(b)(2)
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that Respondent comply with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(b)(2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See guidance for §11.58(b)(1): subsection (b)(2) is separately ordered; the Order requires compliance with the full set of duties enumerated in §11.58(b).

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(b)(3)
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that Respondent comply with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(b)(3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Order lists (b)(3) as a distinct compliance obligation; content of the regulation itself governs the required conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(b)(4)
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that Respondent comply with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(b)(4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order requires adherence to this subsection as part of the duties while excluded; the Order does not restate the regulatory text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(b)(5)
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that Respondent comply with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(b)(5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subsection (b)(5) is enumerated as a required compliance item; practitioners should consult the regulation for specific obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(b)(6)
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that Respondent comply with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(b)(6).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Order requires compliance with (b)(6) in addition to the other (b) subsections; the regulation provides the operative duties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(c)
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that Respondent comply with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Order lists §11.58(c) among required duties during exclusion; consult the regulation for details (the Order does not reproduce its text).

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(d)
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that Respondent comply with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(d).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order mandates compliance with subsection (d) as part of the exclusion obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(e)
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that Respondent comply with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(e).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subsection (e) is separately ordered; the practitioner must follow the regulatory duties set forth there during exclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(f)
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that Respondent comply with 37 C.F.R. §11.58(f).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Order requires compliance with subsection (f) in addition to the other subsections of §11.58.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reinstatement procedures under 37 C.F.R. §11.60
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that Respondent comply with 37 C.F.R. §11.60 should Respondent seek reinstatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Order points to §11.60 as the regulatory framework governing petitions or procedures for reinstatement to practice before the USPTO; specific requirements are in the regulation itself.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificate of service and mailing requirements (37 C.F.R. §11.11 reference)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Final Order includes a Certificate of Service certifying that the Final Order was mailed first class certified mail, return receipt requested, to the Respondent at the address provided to OED pursuant to 37 C.F.R. §11.11.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural requirement: service by certified mail to the address on file under §11.11. The Certificate of Service documents proper notice to the respondent as required by the regulations.
